name: @mandat/desktop
description: Harness desktop: the same web UI in an Electron window, with a native layer (D-303, E9g). Not in the pnpm workspace; installed on demand.

scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && node scripts/bundle-harness.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/bundle-harness.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build && node scripts/bundle-harness.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux --publish never
